_comment: ChatGPT Desktop MCP configuration for josh-personal tenant. chatgpt-desktop-josh is read-only (memory:read, sourceWeight=0.6). ChatGPT Desktop uses the stateful Streamable HTTP transport rather than stdio. Start the HTTP server first: node dist/index.js http. OMNIMIND_MCP_API_KEY is the INBOUND bearer token (required; the server refuses to start without it) and must equal the Authorization header below. OMNIMIND_MCP_AGENT_KEY is the omk_ key from keygen for chatgpt-desktop-josh (outbound x-agent-key to OmniMind). OMNIMIND_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS lists the exact Host header values accepted (DNS-rebinding protection). OMNIMIND_MCP_USER_ID is OPTIONAL (Phase 6): the user the omnimind:// resources read as; tools always take userId explicitly. Remove the line to disable resources.
_health_check: curl -s http://localhost:3334/health  (no auth; returns {status, uptime, sessions, agent, tenant})
